title.narrative: "Protection and rehabilitation - in the Chernihiv, Sumy and Dnipropetrovsk regions, sustainable recovery of Ukrainian civilians affected by the war"

description.narrative: ltpgtThe project aims to provide support to affected civilians and people with disabilities in areas that have been particularly affected by the full-scale invasion and continue to suffer due to their geographical location. The problem lies in the limited access of civilian wounded to rehabilitation services and insufficient protection of their rights. The project aims to improve this situation by ensuring the availability of rehabilitation services and legal protection and support for injured persons.ltbrgtThe goals of the project include improving the accessibility of civilian wounded to rehabilitation services, identifying barriers in protecting their rights, and providing legal protection that will provide a permanent result in confirming and obtaining the disability group and the status of "person with a disability due to war" , which as a result will provide the injured persons with benefits and subsidies from the state and, thanks to rehabilitation measures, will lead to the return of injured persons to a full-fledged life, providing them with the opportunity to actively participate in society and restore normal physical functioning.ltbrgtThe project will cover the Sumy region: Shostkinsky, Konotopsky, Sumy, Okhtyrskyi districts, Chernihiv region: Koryukivskyi, Novgorod-Siverskyi, Chernihivskyi districts and Dnipropetrovsk region: Nikopolskyi, Sinelnikyvskyi, Kryvorizkyi districts.ltbrgtDuring the implementation of the project, according to preliminary assessments and monitoring, about 1070 injured citizens, including at least 140 people with disabilities, will receive support, services and assistance from the project. Of these, for more than 350 people (vulnerable segments of the population and those people who received serious injuries), we will provide individual legal case management aimed at obtaining the status of "person with a disability as a result of the war" and realizing their rights in accordance with the legislation of Ukraine. More than 720 people will receive general advice on protection and legal protection issues at the community level, including involving organizations of people with disabilities in this working process. Among these, Identification of more than 500 people in hospitals for further referral to rehabilitation centers and provision of physical rehabilitation. More than 50 vulnerable people will receive direct physical rehabilitation in special emergency cases and 100 vulnerable people will receive direct cash assistance for health and nutrition.ltbrgtPartner local organizations that unite people with disabilities will be involved in the project, this will provide the necessary expertise and assistance in the implementation of the project. The project seeks to create sustainable conditions for the recovery and protection of the rights of those affected by war, contributing to the sustainable recovery and support of wounded citizens and persons with disabilities.ltbrgtlt/pgt
